# Fira Sans

Fira Sans Latin WOFF2 files, Regular (400), Bold (700), and Italic (400),
downloaded from the version recorded in `SOURCE.txt`.
The Latin subset covers the blog's Indonesian and English text.
The browser uses the system fallback for other scripts and emoji.

Source package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fontsource/fira-sans
Original typeface: https://github.com/mozilla/Fira
License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, see Fira-LICENSE.txt.

Files are served from this repository. No font CDN is contacted by readers.
